sources.title: Separated by a common im/politeness marker: please in American and British web-based English
sources.paraphrase: Please occurs with imperatives and multiple communicative functions; its pragmatic effects depend on context and national variety. It can also carry urgency or mock politeness.
sources.scopeLimit: This study does not establish that adding please leaves all pragmatic meaning identical, and does not label the hatch control.
